memories.content: The founder has been privately informed by Tidepool's head of support that some critical reviews were indeed deleted. Two journalists have emailed for comment. The founder is deciding whether to post a public response to the viral thread.

A viral thread on social media, with two million views and screenshots that look genuine, accuses Tidepool of deleting critical reviews. The thread is publicly visible. Two journalists have emailed Tidepool for comment.
